headlines.name: Math115.ListedAcceptance.listed_completionDecision
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (x : Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L) (proposal : Option (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L))
  (A : Math115.PhysicalStationarySuccess.Fibre r c U L x),
  OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionTranslation.completionDecision
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.listedRows r c U L (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.capacity r c U L) hr)
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.listedColumns r c U L (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.capacity r c U L) hc) x
      proposal (Math115.ListedAcceptance.listedCompletion r c U L hr hc x A) =
    OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionTranslation.completionDecision
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceRows r c U L (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.capacity r c U L)
        ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv r U hr) none))
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceColumns r c U L (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.capacity r c U L)
        ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv c U hc) none))
      x proposal (Math115.ListedAcceptance.referenceCompletion r c U L hr hc x A)

headlines.name: Math115.ListedAcceptance.draw_listed_code
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (x : Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L) (h : ℕ)
  (word : Fin (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.bits r c U L hr hc x h) → Bool),
  Math115.LatticeSampler.draw
      (((List.ofFn (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseRows r c U L hr x),
            List.ofFn (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseColumns r c U L hc x)),
          h),
        List.ofFn word) =
    OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.tableOutput (Math115.ListedAcceptance.listedDraw r c U L hr hc x h word)

headlines.name: Math115.ListedAcceptance.translationValid_draw
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (x y : Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L) (h : ℕ)
  (word : Fin (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.bits r c U L hr hc x h) → Bool),
  OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.translationValid
        (((List.ofFn (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseRows r c U L hr x),
              List.ofFn (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseColumns r c U L hc x)),
            List.ofFn (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseRows r c U L hr y),
            List.ofFn (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseColumns r c U L hc y)),
          Math115.LatticeSampler.draw
            (((List.ofFn (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseRows r c U L hr x),
                  List.ofFn (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseColumns r c U L hc x)),
                h),
              List.ofFn word)) =
      true ↔
    ∀ (i : Option { i // i ≠ (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv r U hr) none })
      (j : Option { j // j ≠ (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv c U hc) none }),
      0 ≤
        ↑(↑(Math115.ListedAcceptance.referenceCompletion r c U L hr hc x
                  (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.completionDraw r c U L hr hc x h word))
              i j) +
          OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionTranslation.between
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceRows r c U L (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.capacity r c U L)
              ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv r U hr) none) x)
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceRows r c U L (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.capacity r c U L)
              ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv r U hr) none) y)
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceColumns r c U L
              (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.capacity r c U L)
              ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv c U hc) none) x)
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceColumns r c U L
              (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.capacity r c U L)
              ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv c U hc) none) y)
            i j

headlines.name: Math115.ListedAcceptance.draw_completionDecision
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (x : Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L) (proposal : Option (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L)) (h : ℕ)
  (word : Fin (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.bits r c U L hr hc x h) → Bool),
  (match proposal with
    | none => x
    | some y =>
      if
          OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.translationValid
              (((List.ofFn (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseRows r c U L hr x),
                    List.ofFn (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseColumns r c U L hc x)),
                  List.ofFn (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseRows r c U L hr y),
                  List.ofFn (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseColumns r c U L hc y)),
                Math115.LatticeSampler.draw
                  (((List.ofFn (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseRows r c U L hr x),
                        List.ofFn (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseColumns r c U L hc x)),
                      h),
                    List.ofFn word)) =
            true then
        y
      else x) =
    OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionTranslation.completionDecision
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceRows r c U L (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.capacity r c U L)
        ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv r U hr) none))
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.referenceColumns r c U L (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.capacity r c U L)
        ((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.largeOptionEquiv c U hc) none))
      x proposal
      (Math115.ListedAcceptance.referenceCompletion r c U L hr hc x
        (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.completionDraw r c U L hr hc x h word))
